description: Heart rate zones from a saved Zone 2 range and an age maximum; cardio minutes per day and week split by zone from per-minute samples; minutes with no sample counted apart
notes: Zone 2 is 110 to 125 bpm; born 1970, so in 2026 the age is 56 and the maximum is 208 - 0.7 x 56 = 168.8, rounded 169.

Zones 3 to 5 split 125 to 169 evenly: step (169 - 125) / 3 = 14.667; Zone 3 tops at round(139.667) = 140, Zone 4 at round(154.333) = 154. So Zone 1 is up to 109, Zone 2 110 to 125, Zone 3 126 to 140, Zone 4 141 to 154, Zone 5 155 and up.
zoneOf: 109.9 is under 110, Zone 1; 110 and 125 are Zone 2; 125.5 is over 125, Zone 3; 140 Zone 3; 141 and 154 Zone 4; 154.5 and 200 Zone 5.

Mar 2: an Elliptical of 1,200 s (20 minutes) with 20 samples (5 at 105, 10 at 118, 3 at 130, 1 at 150, 1 at 160) counts Zones 5, 10, 3, 1, 1 and no gap; an Outdoor Walk of 1,800 s (30 minutes) with 20 samples at 100 adds 20 to Zone 1 and 30 - 20 = 10 minutes with no detail. A strength workout that day is left out (not cardio). Day: Zones 25, 10, 3, 1, 1, no detail 10, total 50.
Mar 4: an Outdoor Walk of 900 s (15 minutes) with no samples: no detail 15, total 15. Mar 1 and Mar 3 have nothing.
Week of Mar 1 to Mar 7 (today Wednesday Mar 4, the week ends Saturday Mar 7): Zones 25, 10, 3, 1, 1, no detail 25, total 65.
Without bounds (no Zone 2 range), Mar 2's 50 minutes are all no detail.

Months over 60 days ending Mar 4: Mar 4 less 59 days is Jan 4, so Jan (whole), Feb (whole, 2026 has 28 days) and Mar 1 to Mar 4. Jan has nothing; Feb has the Feb 10 Elliptical (Zone 2 30, no detail 10, total 40); Mar 1 to 4 is the week's 25, 10, 3, 1, 1, no detail 25, total 65.

Weekly review, week ending Sat Mar 7 (Mar 1 to Mar 7): the same 25, 10, 3, 1, 1, no detail 25, total 65. Baseline Feb 1 to Feb 28: one Elliptical on Feb 10 of 2,400 s (40 minutes) with 30 samples at 120 (Zone 2), so Zone 2 30 and no detail 10, total 40; per week (28 days is 4 weeks) Zone 2 round(7.5) = 8, no detail round(2.5) = 3, total 10.
